note: Information only. Natasha decides what to apply for. Always confirm dates, fees and eligibility with the organisers.

items.title: Kangra Art Museum shows
items.blurb: An international group painting exhibition was held at the museum in Dec 2024. Watch the museum and local arts bodies for the next one.

items.title: Artscapes Women Artists Exhibition
items.blurb: Annual juried show for women artists, any career stage. The 2026 call closed on 9 Jan with a ₹850 entry fee for professionals. The 2027 call is expected around the same time of year.

items.title: Chandigarh Lalit Kala Akademi annual exhibition
items.blurb: The Akademi lists an annual art exhibition form under Downloads. Deadlines are not published on the page,.

items.title: Chitra Santhe
items.blurb: Open-air art market run by Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath. About 1,500 artists sold directly to the public in 2025, with around 5 lakh visitors. Application window not confirmed.

items.title: Kala Ghoda Arts Festival
items.blurb: Nine-day arts festival in South Mumbai, theme MultipliCity. No visual-artist stall route has been announced yet.

items.title: India Art Fair
items.blurb: Independent artists cannot apply to the main sections; applications closed in 2026. Good for meeting galleries. Open calls appear on its Noticeboard.

items.title: CIMA Art Mela
items.blurb: An affordable art fair with works listed from ₹5,000 to ₹5 lakh. No 2026 edition found yet.

items.title: Lalit Kala Akademi National Exhibition of Art
items.blurb: The 65th edition, with 20 awards, was held in 2026. Watch the Akademi's site for the next call.

items.title: Affordable Art Fair
items.blurb: Galleries exhibit at these fairs (97 in Singapore in 2026), so the way in is a gallery that represents an artist. An online portfolio is the first step.
